get_MpsPlatform_device_total_memory: get the total system memory available for MPS device using MpsPlatform.get_device_total_memory
get_MpsPlatform_available_gpu_memory: get the available GPU memory for MPS device using MpsPlatform.get_available_gpu_memory
get_MpsPlatform_attn_backend: get the attention backend class string for MPS device using MpsPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls_str
get_MpsPlatform_current_memory_usage: get the current memory usage on MPS device using MpsPlatform.get_current_memory_usage
set_MpsPlatform_seed_everything: set random seeds for MPS device reproducibility using MpsPlatform.seed_everything
